title: Cathie Wood Bets Big On Musk As SpaceX–xAI Merger Anchors 17.5% Of ARK Fund
title_zh: SpaceX 与 xAI 合并，凯茜·伍德 (Cathie Wood) 在马斯克身上押下重注，持有 ARK 基金 17.5% 的股份
summary: Cathie Wood's flagship venture fund has realigned its heaviest bets following a record-breaking merger between Elon Musk's aerospace giant and his artificial intelligence startup.
summary_zh: 在埃隆·马斯克的航空航天巨头和他的人工智能初创公司破纪录的合并之后，凯西·伍德的旗舰风险基金重新调整了其最大的赌注。

title: KKR & Co. CFO Sees Better 2026 Deal Outlook, Says Diversified Earnings Aren’t Priced In
title_zh: KKR & Co. 首席财务官认为 2026 年交易前景更好，表示多元化收益并未反映在定价中
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. (NYSE:KKR) CFO Rob Lewin said the firm is entering 2026 with improving visibility into deal activity, stronger fundraising momentum, and a more diversified earnings base that he believes is not fully reflected in the company’s share price.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：KKR）首席财务官 Rob Lewin 表示，进入 2026 年，该公司交易活动的可见性不断提高，融资势头更加强劲，盈利基础更加多元化，他认为这些并没有完全反映在公司股价中。

title: KKR to Add Sports Franchise Exposure Through Arctos Acquisition
title_zh: KKR 将通过收购 Arctos 增加体育特许经营业务
summary: KKR & Co. is set to acquire Arctos Partners in a $1.4B stock-and-cash deal, boosting its sports investing platform and launching a new Solutions business.
summary_zh: KKR & Co. 计划以 1.4 亿美元的股票和现金交易收购 Arctos Partners，从而增强其体育投资平台并推出新的解决方案业务。
